design.text: Multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized discontinuation (withdrawal) study; after an open-label run-in optimal-dose phase, patients were randomized 1:1 to continue amifampridine phosphate or downtitrate to placebo, with the primary endpoint assessed on Day 14.

citations.quote: The study is a Phase 3, multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized withdrawal study in adult patients diagnosed with LEMS.

Patients were randomized using IXRS in a double-blind fashion in a 1:1 ratio to either (1) continued treatment with amifampridine phosphate for 7 days or (2) discontinued treatment with amifampridine phosphate via a downward titration to placebo over 7 days.

The co-primary endpoints, change from baseline in Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) and Subject Global Impression (SGI) scores, were assessed at the end of the withdrawal period on Day 14 and Day 4 for Studies LMS-002 and LMS-003, respectively.
